## Video decoder

Background videos the browser cannot decode play through a separate module, `video/ddivideo.wasm`, fetched only when a song needs it. It uses code of [FFmpeg 9.0.2](https://ffmpeg.org/) licensed under the [GNU LGPL 2.1 or later](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.1.html); its source, unmodified, is served next to the module: [`video/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz`](https://sugoijan.dev/ditoditoinfinito/video/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz) (SHA-256 `8c3850283eb25fa026482078a04051e0be17347b09ef81a0849bec15a96e002e`; the [release](https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz) at FFmpeg, tag: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n9.0.2). It is built by `video/build.sh` with the configure flags below and linked with `video/ddivideo.c` and `video/packets.c` (this repository's code, MIT); the build script rebuilds it, also against a modified FFmpeg.

Also in the module:

- [zlib 1.3.2](https://zlib.net/) — [zlib licence](https://zlib.net/zlib_license.html)
- [wasi-libc from wasi-sdk 34.0, with parts from musl (MIT), cloudlibc (BSD-2-Clause) and dlmalloc (public domain)](https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-libc/tree/2e6fb9d8ee0cdf9e431fbcabe8af3115de000a13) — [MIT](https://opensource.org/license/mit)
- [LLVM compiler-rt builtins from wasi-sdk 34.0](https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk) — [Apache 2.0 with LLVM Exceptions](https://llvm.org/LICENSE.txt)

The licence texts are served next to the module (`video/ddivideo.LICENSE.txt`) in builds that include it.

Configure flags (after the toolchain's `--cc`, `--ar` and the zlib paths):

```
--target-os=none
--arch=wasm32
--enable-cross-compile
--disable-everything
--disable-programs
--disable-doc
--disable-network
--disable-pthreads
--disable-w32threads
--disable-os2threads
--disable-runtime-cpudetect
--disable-autodetect
--disable-debug
--disable-avdevice
--disable-avfilter
--disable-swresample
--enable-avcodec
--enable-avformat
--enable-swscale
--enable-demuxers
--enable-parsers
--enable-protocol=file
--enable-zlib
--enable-small
--extra-cflags=-msimd128 -Oz
--enable-decoder=aasc,agm,aic,alias_pix,amv,anm,ansi,apng,apv,arbc,argo,asv1,asv2,aura,aura2,avrn,avrp,avs,avui,bethsoftvid,bfi,bink,bintext,bitpacked,bmp,bmv_video,brender_pix,c93,cavs,cdgraphics,cdtoons,cdxl,cfhd,cinepak,clearvideo,cljr,cllc,cpia,cri,cscd,cyuv,dds,dfa,dirac,dnxhd,dpx,dsicinvideo,dvvideo,dxa,dxtory,dxv,eacmv,eamad,eatgq,eatgv,eatqi,eightbps,escape124,escape130,exr,ffv1,ffvhuff,fic,fits,flashsv,flashsv2,flic,flv,fmvc,fourxm,fraps,frwu,g2m,gdv,gem,gif,h261,h263,h263i,h263p,h264,hap,hdr,hevc,hnm4_video,hq_hqa,hqx,huffyuv,hymt,idcin,idf,iff_ilbm,imm4,imm5,indeo2,indeo3,indeo4,indeo5,interplay_video,ipu,jpeg2000,jpegls,jv,kgv1,kmvc,lagarith,lead,loco,lscr,m101,magicyuv,mdec,media100,mimic,mjpeg,mjpegb,mmvideo,mobiclip,motionpixels,mpeg1video,mpeg2video,mpeg4,mpegvideo,msa1,mscc,msmpeg4v1,msmpeg4v2,msmpeg4v3,msp2,msrle,mss1,mss2,msvideo1,mszh,mts2,mv30,mvc1,mvc2,mvdv,mvha,mwsc,mxpeg,notchlc,nuv,paf_video,pam,pbm,pcx,pdv,pfm,pgm,pgmyuv,pgx,phm,photocd,pictor,pixlet,png,ppm,prores,prores_raw,prosumer,psd,ptx,qdraw,qoi,qpeg,qtrle,r10k,r210,rasc,rawvideo,rl2,roq,rpza,rscc,rtv1,rv10,rv20,rv30,rv40,rv60,sanm,scpr,screenpresso,sga,sgi,sgirle,sheervideo,simbiosis_imx,smacker,smc,smvjpeg,snow,sp5x,speedhq,srgc,sunrast,svq1,svq3,targa,targa_y216,tdsc,theora,thp,tiertexseqvideo,tiff,tmv,truemotion1,truemotion2,truemotion2rt,tscc,tscc2,txd,ulti,utvideo,v210,v210x,vb,vble,vbn,vc1,vc1image,vcr1,vmdvideo,vmix,vmnc,vp3,vp4,vp5,vp6,vp6a,vp6f,vp7,vp8,vp9,vqa,vqc,vvc,wbmp,wcmv,webp,webp_anim,wmv1,wmv2,wmv3,wmv3image,wnv1,xan_wc3,xan_wc4,xbin,xbm,xface,xl,xpm,xwd,y41p,ylc,yop,yuv4,zero12v,zerocodec,zlib,zmbv
```

On desktop the same FFmpeg release, with zlib, is linked statically into a separate program, `ddi-video-helper` (`video/helper`, MIT), which decodes in a sandboxed process of its own; the game never links FFmpeg. It is built by `video/build-native.sh` with the configure flags below and the desktop's packages ship it with its notice (`video/ddi-video-helper.LICENSE.txt`), FFmpeg's source and the helper's source, so it can be rebuilt against a modified FFmpeg (`cargo build -p ddi-video-helper`).

Configure flags of the desktop helper's FFmpeg (after `--prefix` and the toolchain's):

```
--disable-everything
--disable-programs
--disable-doc
--disable-network
--disable-protocols
--disable-autodetect
--disable-debug
--disable-avdevice
--disable-avfilter
--disable-swresample
--disable-shared
--enable-static
--enable-pic
--enable-avcodec
--enable-avformat
--enable-swscale
--enable-demuxers
```

### StepMania 5.1

The metrics.ini and Lua files of its dance/default, pump/default and common/common noteskins, byte for byte: the stand-ins every imported noteskin falls back to. ## Rust libraries

The game is built on open-source Rust libraries (crates): 159 in the web build (the app and its Opus and SVG workers) and 324 in the desktop app (Linux, macOS and Windows). Their names, versions and licences, and the 157 licence notices they ask to ship, are in [THIRD_PARTY_RUST.md](THIRD_PARTY_RUST.md) and on the Credits screen.
